prose: A Financial Times report indexed by Techmeme argues that an Anthropic IPO could shift venture-capital standings, with some smaller investors positioned for large multiples. The full article was inaccessible. Holdings, entry prices, dilution and the assumptions behind projected returns were not inspected; potential gains are not realized proceeds.
highlights: Evidence is limited to an indexed excerpt
Investor positions were not independently checked
Return multiples depend on entry terms and dilution
Projected gains are not realized cash
